notes: Both directive-he tokens (s012, s026, s031) take the ASV's to under rule 32 rather than going unrepresented, since the ASV writes a word of its own for the motion in each case.

The two occurrences of מִנֶּגֶב are read differently on purpose: the first is fused into southward (one English word, rule 30) with אֶל unrepresented, the second is split as by / the south because the ASV spends a word on the preposition itself.
